parameters.query: WITH ph AS (SELECT '+' || CASE WHEN length(d) = 8 THEN '973' || d ELSE regexp_replace(d, '^00', '') END FROM (SELECT regexp_replace($2, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS d) z) , pk AS (UPDATE packages SET seats_available = seats_available - GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF($3,'')::int, 1), 1) WHERE id = NULLIF($1,'')::int AND (seats_available IS NULL OR seats_available >= GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF($3,'')::int, 1), 1)) RETURNING id, title, price, seats_available, departure_date), cu AS (INSERT INTO customers (phone, full_name) SELECT ph.p, NULLIF($4,'') FROM (SELECT (SELECT * FROM ph) AS p) ph ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET full_name = COALESCE(customers.full_name, EXCLUDED.full_name) RETURNING id), bk AS (INSERT INTO bookings (package_id, customer_phone, lead_name, lead_email, travelers_count, notes, booking_status, payment_status, amount_paid, total_amount) SELECT pk.id, (SELECT * FROM ph), NULLIF($4,''), NULLIF($5,''), GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF($3,'')::int, 1), 1), NULLIF($8,''), COALESCE(NULLIF($9,''), 'confirmed'), CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF($7,'')::numeric, 0) <= 0 THEN 'unpaid' WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF($7,'')::numeric, 0) >= COALESCE(NULLIF($6,'')::numeric, pk.price * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF($3,'')::int, 1), 1)) THEN 'paid' ELSE 'partial' END, COALESCE(NULLIF($7,'')::numeric, 0), COALESCE(NULLIF($6,'')::numeric, pk.price * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF($3,'')::int, 1), 1)) FROM pk RETURNING *), lg AS (INSERT INTO audit_log (actor_type, actor_id, action, entity, entity_id, workflow, details) SELECT 'agent', 'staff_' || $10, 'booking_create', 'bookings', id::text, 'Personal AI Agent', jsonb_build_object('package_id', package_id, 'travelers', travelers_count, 'total', total_amount) FROM bk) SELECT (SELECT row_to_json(bk) FROM bk) AS booking, (SELECT row_to_json(pk) FROM pk) AS package_after, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pk) THEN 'Package not found or not enough seats. Nothing was booked.' ELSE '' END AS error

WITH old AS (SELECT * FROM bookings WHERE id = NULLIF($1,'')::int), u AS (UPDATE bookings b SET booking_status = COALESCE(NULLIF($2,''), b.booking_status), payment_status = COALESCE(NULLIF($3,''), b.payment_status), amount_paid = COALESCE(NULLIF($4,'')::numeric, b.amount_paid), total_amount = COALESCE(NULLIF($5,'')::numeric, b.total_amount), travelers_count = COALESCE(NULLIF($6,'')::int, b.travelers_count), notes = COALESCE(NULLIF($7,''), b.notes) WHERE b.id = NULLIF($1,'')::int RETURNING b.*), seat AS (UPDATE packages p SET seats_available = p.seats_available + (CASE WHEN u.booking_status = 'cancelled' AND COALESCE(old.booking_status,'') <> 'cancelled' THEN COALESCE(old.travelers_count,0) WHEN u.booking_status <> 'cancelled' AND COALESCE(old.booking_status,'') = 'cancelled' THEN -COALESCE(u.travelers_count,0) WHEN u.booking_status <> 'cancelled' THEN COALESCE(old.travelers_count,0) - COALESCE(u.travelers_count,0) ELSE 0 END) FROM u, old WHERE p.id = u.package_id RETURNING p.id, p.seats_available), lg AS (INSERT INTO audit_log (actor_type, actor_id, action, entity, entity_id, workflow, details) SELECT 'agent', 'staff_' || $8, 'booking_update', 'bookings', u.id::text, 'Personal AI Agent', jsonb_build_object('before', to_jsonb(old), 'after', to_jsonb(u)) FROM u, old) SELECT (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM u) AS booking, (SELECT row_to_json(seat) FROM seat) AS package_seats, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u) THEN 'Booking not found' ELSE '' END AS error

WITH x AS (INSERT INTO customers (phone, full_name, notes, whatsapp_opt_in) VALUES ((SELECT '+' || CASE WHEN length(d) = 8 THEN '973' || d ELSE regexp_replace(d, '^00', '') END FROM (SELECT regexp_replace($1, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS d) z), NULLIF($2,''), NULLIF($3,''), COALESCE(NULLIF($4,'')::boolean, true)) ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET full_name = COALESCE(NULLIF($2,''), customers.full_name), notes = COALESCE(NULLIF($3,''), customers.notes), whatsapp_opt_in = COALESCE(NULLIF($4,'')::boolean, customers.whatsapp_opt_in) RETURNING id, phone, full_name, notes, whatsapp_opt_in), lg AS (INSERT INTO audit_log (actor_type, actor_id, action, entity, entity_id, workflow, details) SELECT 'agent', 'staff_' || $5, 'customer_save', 'customers', id::text, 'Personal AI Agent', jsonb_build_object('name', full_name) FROM x) SELECT * FROM x

INSERT INTO travelers (booking_id, title, first_name, last_name, dob, nationality, passport_number) SELECT NULLIF($1,'')::int, x.title, x.first_name, x.last_name, x.dob, x.nationality, x.passport_number FROM jsonb_to_recordset(COALESCE(NULLIF($2,''),'[]')::jsonb) AS x(title text, first_name text, last_name text, dob date, nationality text, passport_number text) RETURNING id, booking_id, first_name, last_name, passport_number

WITH it AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('desc', x->>'desc', 'qty', COALESCE((x->>'qty')::numeric, 1), 'price', COALESCE((x->>'price')::numeric, 0), 'amount', COALESCE((x->>'qty')::numeric, 1) * COALESCE((x->>'price')::numeric, 0))), '[]'::jsonb) AS items, coalesce(sum(COALESCE((x->>'qty')::numeric, 1) * COALESCE((x->>'price')::numeric, 0)), 0) AS sub FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF($4,''), '[]')::jsonb) x) INSERT INTO invoices (number, customer_name, customer_phone, booking_id, items, subtotal, discount, total, notes, created_by) SELECT 'INV-' || to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bahrain', 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || lpad(((SELECT coalesce(max(id), 0) FROM invoices) + 1)::text, 3, '0'), NULLIF($1,''), NULLIF($2,''), NULLIF($3,'')::int, it.items, it.sub, COALESCE(NULLIF($5,'')::numeric, 0), it.sub - COALESCE(NULLIF($5,'')::numeric, 0), NULLIF($6,''), 'staff_' || $7 FROM it RETURNING *
